FIELDS.NAME: Vitality Market
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Vitality Market operates as a retail health food and vitamin store, focusing exclusively on offering FDA-approved vitamins, dietary supplements, and organic health foods sourced from suppliers with verifiable certifications. Our commitment to product safety and regulatory compliance ensures that all products sold meet stringent health standards, significantly reducing liability exposure. 

We maintain robust safety practices for the storage and handling of our inventory, including regular audits to remove expired or recalled products. Customer service is paramount; we promptly address any customer complaints and document the resolution process to enhance our operational integrity. Our team is trained on product knowledge and safety regulations, creating a knowledgeable environment for our customers.

Both in-store and online transactions are secured with advanced payment systems, minimizing the risk of fraud and data breaches. Additionally, we strive to support our customers with clear and substantiated health claims, backed by scientific evidence, which complies with FDA and FTC guidelines. Overall, our operations are designed to promote health and wellness while ensuring compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in the sale of unregulated, black-market, or banned supplements and confirms that all vitamins, supplements, and health foods are sourced from suppliers with verifiable certifications. We maintain documented safety practices for the storage, handling, and display of all products, and our operations strictly refrain from any on-site compounding or manufacturing of supplements without the appropriate licensing and quality controls.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, a theft occurred at our store, resulting in a loss of $3,000. The items stolen were various dietary supplements and health foods. The status of the claim is pending investigation by local law enforcement. Additionally, on 01/10/2023, we had to discard expired inventory totaling $2,000 due to our routine inventory audit. This was processed and documented as per our compliance and safety protocols.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-Duty Fireproof Safe - Class B, Grade 1, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24/7 Security monitoring system installed, supplemented with periodic on-site security personnel during peak hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Vitality Market does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our operations are focused on selling FDA-approved vitamins, dietary supplements, and organic health foods from certified suppliers.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Vitality Market does not sponsor any athletic teams. Our focus is solely on providing FDA-approved health food and vitamin products in our retail operations.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Our compliance manager, Sarah Johnson, is responsible for checking and verifying these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Vitality Market has not been indicted or convicted of any crime related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We maintain a strong commitment to ethical business practices.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Vitality Market has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. We maintain compliance with all policies and have a strong operational record.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Vitality Market does not lease employees to or from other employers. We maintain a dedicated team of employees solely for our operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Vitality Market carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect our employees in case of workplace injuries.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Vitality Market owns and operates another business named Healthy Life Supplements, LLC, which also focuses on health-related products.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Vitality Market does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. We maintain primary coverage through our current policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Vitality Market is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. We focus exclusively on retailing FDA-approved vitamins and health foods sourced from certified suppliers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Vitality Market does not rent or loan equipment to others as our operations are focused exclusively on the retail sale of FDA-approved vitamins, dietary supplements, and organic health foods. This practice helps maintain compliance with safety and liability standards.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Vitality Market has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. All financial transactions and operations have been conducted in good standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Vitality Market does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or hazardous chemicals, as our operations focus solely on selling FDA-approved vitamins and health foods from certified suppliers. Our safety practices ensure that we maintain a compliant and secure retail environment.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Vitality Market does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations are focused on the retail sale of FDA-approved vitamins and health foods, without involvement in high-risk activities or locations.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Vitality Market has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain a strong focus on compliance and employee training to prevent such issues.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Vitality Market currently does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. Our operations comply with all relevant safety regulations and inspections have been conducted regularly to ensure fire safety standards are met.
